description.value: Pizza Rubato Napoletana is a Neo-Neapolitan pizzeria on West Broadway that takes its name from the musical concept of 'tempo rubato' — staying rooted in 300-year-old Neapolitan tradition while freely riffing on ingredients and flavour combinations. The kitchen uses imported Italian '00' flour, a 48-hour fermentation process, and an AVPN-approved Valoriani oven that replicates a wood-fired experience, producing a crispy, charred crust. Cyclists heading along the Broadway corridor will find an extensive creative menu alongside catering and events services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active Neapolitan pizza restaurant at 561 W Broadway, Vancouver. Phone and address in OSM match the website exactly. The website features a prominent 'ORDER NOW' button confirming takeout/online ordering; a Verdure section on the menu shows multiple meatless pizzas (Margherita, Verde Noce, Funghi Tartufo, Pesto Spinaci, etc.) confirming vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate sit-down restaurant on the West Broadway cycling corridor with confirmed online ordering and a broad menu including vegetarian options; a useful meal stop for touring cyclists despite unconfirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
